summary.text: Jake Hoffman, a Republican, represents District 15 in the Arizona State Senate; the legislature's member page lists his Senate service as beginning in 2023 and his House service as 2021 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, he previously served on the Higley School Board and the Queen Creek Town Council and was a delegate to the 2016 and 2020 Republican National Conventions.
The biography also describes him as president and CEO of multiple technology, marketing and communications strategy small businesses.
